required_fixes: Freeze the origin pool in freeze.json with SHA256 (prereg s7.1, freeze.json omits frozen_origins.json). The current pool is executor-constructed post-freeze (V-A).

Resolve the contradictory positive-control thresholds: s9.1 requires >2.0 nats log predictive density (arithmetically unattainable with 10-component signature + EPS=0.02, max = -0.202 nats); s13 condition 6 requires >-0.5 nats. One must be removed or corrected before freeze (V-C).

Redesign NC_INDEPENDENT_IID (V-D): the i.i.d. null draws from per-site marginals but the comparator B3 is a global cold re-derivation. Any predictor keyed on (site, action_template) — which B1 and the treatment are — must beat B3 on this data without reading any mechanism. The confound-free reference is the per-site marginal oracle; against it the treatment is worse (-1.804 nats).

Pre-freeze pilot_data.json and power_calculation.json must exist and be hashed in freeze.json (prereg s12, s15). The tabulated pilot values (-2.34 vs -1.87 nats) are outside the attainable range of the frozen metric, indicating a different metric was used for power planning.

Increase the site count to meet the pre-freeze power assumption (20 sites, ~900 held-out cases). Current: 5 sites, 66 held-out cases, 118 distinct site-resample compositions in 1000 bootstrap draws (V-F).

The mandate's disjoint-host-set clause must be enforced at the POOL level by pre-freezing the Graph/Frontier host sets and the candidate universe, not by post-hoc executor filtering that removes the only origins with 200/404-varying identifier templates (V-M, V-N).

validity_findings.finding: prereg s7.1 asserts 25 origins / 12 unique but defers the list to frozen_origins.json which freeze.json neither references nor hashes. The measured pool is 6 origins (api.agify.io, api.github.com, api.genderize.io, api.nationalize.io, ifconfig.me, randomuser.me) — 0.24x the 25-origin claim and 0.48x the 12-origin claim. The pool is an executor construction, not frozen evidence. This is the single largest frozen-design defect.

pilot_data.json and power_calculation.json are listed as frozen artifacts in prereg s12/s15 and do not exist. The tabulated pilot log densities (-2.34 / -1.87 nats) are outside the attainable range of the frozen bandwidth-free metric (log_score_categorical range ~[-9, -0.1]), so the power calculation describes a different metric and cannot be audited.

Two contradictory positive-control thresholds exist in the frozen prereg: s9.1 requires log predictive density > 2.0 nats; s12/s13 condition 6 requires > -0.5 nats. With the frozen 10-component discrete signature and EPS=0.02, the maximum attainable log_score_categorical for ANY predictor is 10*log(1-EPS) = -0.2020 nats. The s9.1 threshold is arithmetically unattainable — an instrument defect detectable before any measurement. The PC passes s13 (-0.123 nats) but fails s9.1.

NC_INDEPENDENT_IID draws i.i.d. from each site's TRAIN marginal (prereg s9.3) and requires all predictors to perform at or below B3 (global cold re-derivation, s13 condition 8). B1 is explicitly required by s8.2 to be keyed on (site, action_template), and the treatment inherits this. Any such predictor must beat B3 on per-site-generated data with or without mechanism reading. The treatment beats B3 by +2.227 nats on i.i.d. data but is WORSE than the per-site marginal oracle by -1.804 nats. The control fails by frozen criterion design, not because the predictor hallucinates structure.

prereg s10.1 does not fix the training sample that sets the Silverman bandwidth for log_density_joint, and the joint density has no bandwidth-free zero point. The absolute thresholds in s9.1/s13 are not well-defined on it. The bandwidth-free proper scores (log_score_categorical, brier_categorical) are correctly used as primary; joint density is reported with an explicit bandwidth rule and 4-point sweep where contrast signs are invariant.

Pre-freeze power assumed 20 sites and ~900 held-out cases (prereg s12). Actual: 5 test sites, 66 held-out cases, 118 distinct site-resample compositions in 1000 bootstrap draws. Site-clustered intervals and site-grouped permutations are correspondingly weak. The scientifically decisive B1-vs-treatment contrast has 95% CI [+1.16e-16, +0.0521] — endpoint at zero.

api.agify.io returned HTTP 429 for all 20 requests; api.genderize.io returned 429 for 25 of 35. Two of 5 test sites contribute only rate-limit responses (constant 429 signature, no identifier variation). These templates carry no structure and dilute the held-out sample.

17 of 224 bodies exceeded the 4096-byte archive cap. body_length and body_hash_prefix_8 are computed on the full body, but has_form, form_action_count, link_count, script_count are computed on the prefix and are lower bounds for those responses.

Every arm (treatment and baselines) is keyed on (site, action_template); no site-identity feature enters any predictor. The mechanism library is site-local by construction. The mandate's disjoint-host-set clause is enforced at pool level, not as a held-out-site generalization test. Cross-site mechanism transfer is unmeasured.

Templates discovered from paths observed live on retained hosts (D5), so site sample and template sample are conditioned on what those hosts expose. Held-out identifiers are genuinely never-observed, but action surface choice is not independent of substrate.
Trajectory-grouped permutation null attains only 16 distinct values for B1 contrasts at this sample size, limiting p-value resolution. Site-grouped null is finer (1391 distinct). Both reported.

Web is live: bodies/headers re-fetched per run; rerun would not reproduce byte-identical signatures. Exact seeds and request ledger recorded; analysis exactly reproducible from archived ledger; collection only conditionally reproducible.

frozen_origins.json cites raw/excluded_host_template_inventory.jsonl as measured cost of mandate exclusion, but that file was never produced (probing excluded hosts would violate mandate). The exclusion's cost is quantified from the executed ledger: 4 of 5 mandate-excluded candidates had 200/404-varying identifier templates and no replacement in the retained pool.

Treatment differs from B1 on only 12 of 66 held-out cases (18.2%), all in 2 templates on api.github.com. Delta is exactly 0 on the other 9 templates (frozen mechanism selection returns same predictor as B1). All four B1 site-clustered intervals have an endpoint at exactly zero (one at 1.16e-16). The mechanism increment is not separable from zero at the site-cluster level. Any claim about this increment is a claim about api.github.com, not the Web.

baseline_findings.finding: Strongest baseline. Treatment beats it by +0.0158 nats (log_score_categorical) and -0.000206 (brier_categorical), p_trajectory=0.0002, p_site=0.0001. But site-clustered 95% CI for both metrics includes zero (endpoint at 1.16e-16 and 0.0) because the increment lives entirely in api.github.com. The treatment and B1 are identical predictors on 54/66 held-out cases (9 other templates).

Treatment beats it by +1.762 nats (log_score) and -0.0212 (Brier). But on i.i.d. null (per-site marginal), treatment beats B3 by +2.227 nats while being worse than per-site oracle by -1.804 nats. The large margin over B2 comes from (site, action_template) conditioning — which B1 also has — not mechanism semantics. B2 trajectory-grouped p=0.0546, site-grouped p=0.4284 for Brier (fails p<0.05).

Weakest baseline (global marginal). Treatment beats it by +5.102 nats / -0.226 Brier with tight CIs and p<0.0001. But this comparison is uninformative for mechanism semantics: the i.i.d. control shows the same margin is achieved by site-conditioned memory alone. B3 is the correct no-knowledge floor but not a discriminating baseline for the claim.

PASS. Placebo is a genuine permuted mechanism object (differs from treatment on 30/66 held-out cases, 201 distinct scores across 201 permutations). It performs far below all baselines (log_score -13.145 vs B1 -4.050). Treatment percentile within placebo distribution = 0.0. This control correctly distinguishes a mechanism reader from a label/structure-only reader, unlike the count-preserving relabeling null in the parent packet.

PASS under s13 threshold (log_score_categorical -0.123 > -0.5, Brier 0.00024 < 0.1). FAIL under s9.1 threshold (>2.0 nats, arithmetically unattainable). The accept branch is reachable for the s13 criterion. The contradictory thresholds are an instrument defect (V-C).

DELTA_LOG_SCORE_CATEGORICAL_B1_MARKOV_1S.note: CI endpoint at 1.16e-16 (identically zero in resamples omitting api.github.com); does not satisfy 'excludes zero'

IID_CONTROL_TREATMENT_VS_B3_LOG_SCORE.note: Treatment beats B3 on i.i.d. data but is WORSE than per-site marginal oracle by -1.804 nats. Confounded criterion (V-D).

IID_CONTROL_TREATMENT_VS_PER_SITE_ORACLE.note: Confound-free reference: treatment does not hallucinate mechanism-specific structure on i.i.d. data.

claim_ceiling: On this specific substrate (6 credential-free public origins, response-signature representation with 15 components, site-keyed predictors, 5 test sites, 66 held-out identifier-level cases), inherited-mechanism conditioning adds a small (+0.0158 nats log_score_categorical, -0.000206 brier_categorical), statistically reliable (p_trajectory=0.0002) but site-cluster-CI-non-separable increment over site-conditioned first-order Markov memory, carried entirely by 12/66 held-out cases in api.github.com. The large margins over B2 (+1.762 nats) and B3 (+5.102 nats) are attributable to (site, action_template) conditioning, not mechanism semantics, as demonstrated by the i.i.d. control. Cross-site mechanism transfer, cross-origin generality, and the broader claim C-WEB-DYNAMICS remain unmeasured. The experiment is MEASUREMENT_INVALID per the frozen decision rule due to control failure (V8/condition 8) and multiple pre-freeze instrument defects (V-A, V-B, V-C, V-D, V-F).
evidence_refs: derived/metrics.json (all arms, contrasts, controls, permutation nulls, bootstrap CIs)
unresolved: Whether the +0.0158-nat increment over B1 is real mechanism-conditioned structure or an artifact of site-conditioned memory that the frozen B1 baseline under-specifies: B1's fallback is P(sig | site, action_template), which is the same key the treatment's M0 residual uses.
Whether the increment would survive a held-out-SITE design (mechanism learned on one origin transferring to another). This experiment cannot answer it: every arm is site-keyed (V-I).

Whether the increment is a property of mechanism-conditioned inheritance at all, or a property of api.github.com specifically. Replication on the four mandate-excluded hosts with 200/404-varying identifier templates (httpbin.org, catfact.ninja, dog.ceo, ipify.org) would decide this.
Whether the absent pilot_data.json / power_calculation.json ever existed; the prereg's tabulated pilot values are outside the attainable range of the frozen metric.
Whether api.publicapis.org (in_pool=true in frozen_origins.json but absent from frozen_pool_eTLD1, DNS failure at screen) was intended to be part of the pool.
Whether the rate-limited sites (agify, genderize) would contribute real structure if probed with a slower, budget-respecting schedule.
